import html # Predefined template for a blog post. The placeholders `{title}` and `{body}` # will be replaced by the sanitized heading and content respectively. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(heading: str, content: str) -> str: """ Return a safe, formatted HTML string for displaying a blog entry. Parameters ---------- heading : str The title of the blog post. content : str The main text body of the blog post. Returns ------- str An HTML string with the title and body properly escaped to prevent XSS. """ # Escape user input to neutralize any HTML/JS that could lead to XSS. safe_title = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Use the predefined template to format the blog post. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
